specifications.metric: I-Gard Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR — voltage range
specifications.basis: I-Gard C-098EB Product Brochure, April 2022: 'I-Gard offers a complete range of Neutral Grounding Resistors, from 480V to 69,000V for resistance grounding of industrial power systems.'

specifications.metric: I-Gard Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR — rated time options
specifications.unit: 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute or continuous time
specifications.basis: CSA C22.2 295-15 clause 4.1.2 quoted in I-Gard C-098EB brochure, April 2022: 'Rated time shall be 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute or continuous time.'

specifications.metric: I-Gard Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR — temperature rise, duty-rated example (2400 V L-N, 400 A, 10 s)
specifications.basis: I-Gard C-098EB brochure, April 2022, 'Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR) Ratings and Dimensions' table: 2400 V line-to-neutral, 400 A, 10 seconds, 760 deg C temperature rise.

specifications.metric: I-Gard Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR — temperature rise, continuous example (277 V L-N, 5 A)
specifications.basis: I-Gard C-098EB brochure, April 2022, NGR Ratings and Dimensions table: 277 V, 5 A continuous, 375 deg C temperature rise.

specifications.metric: I-Gard Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR — recommended maximum temperature coefficient of resistance
specifications.basis: I-Gard C-098EB brochure, April 2022: 'it is recommended that the NGR element material to be specified to have a temperature coefficient of resistance no greater than 0.0002 Ohms / deg C.'

specifications.metric: I-Gard Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR — maximum current variation in rated voltage test
specifications.basis: CSA C22.2 295-15 clause 6.2.1 quoted in I-Gard C-098EB brochure, April 2022: 'The current shall not vary from the rated current by more than 20%.'

specifications.metric: I-Gard Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR — maximum resistance change over temperature range
specifications.basis: IEEE C57.32 quoted in I-Gard C-098EB brochure, April 2022: 'The resistance of the NGR should not change by more than 67% from the initial value over the temperature range.'

specifications.metric: I-Gard SIGMA 3 NGR monitor / ground fa — applicable voltage range
specifications.basis: I-Gard C-098EB brochure, April 2022: 'The SIGMA 3 is the I-Gard ground fault relay... it can be used across the whole range of High and Low Resistance Grounding Systems, in voltages from 480V to 69 kV.'

specifications.metric: I-Gard SIGMA 3 NGR monitor / ground fa — neutral-ground monitoring requirement
specifications.basis: I-Gard C-098EB brochure, April 2022: 'All Neutral Grounding Resistors from I-Gard comply with CEC 2021 which requires complete neutral-to-ground path monitoring.'

sources.note: 3D drawing and typical configuration figures in the C-098EB Product Brochure, April 2022; dimensions stated for information only and subject to change.
